profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs consumer hardware, software, and services. The company's website focuses on Apple Intelligence and Siri, which it describes as "truly helpful AI that's centered around you and your needs," integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The next-generation Siri AI is presented as a conversational assistant capable of open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth dialogue, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, on-screen visual queries, writing assistance, and Shortcuts automation. The site notes that Siri AI will launch in beta, will be available in English first, and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, or watchOS.

Apple's tracked AI products include Apple Intelligence, categorized as an on-device large language model built around Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with a stated privacy-first design, along with Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI, both described as on-device video editing tools optimized for Apple silicon. The company reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, filed as a 10-K, and trades on a public exchange under the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193.

Two MCP servers are associated with Apple in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, named ai.b77/apple-search-ads, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients, named com.apple-rag/mcp-server. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
